北半球某地（约75°W，45°N），河流清澈，森林茂密，风景宜人……

<image1>

该河流注入的海域毗邻世界某著名渔场，该渔场位于哪里？
raw_record.final_cot:
First describe the image: the figure shows an outline map of North America and has latitude and longitude lines drawn; the Great Lakes region as well as southeastern Canada and the northeastern United States can be seen on the map. The position of about 75°W, 45°N given in the question stem, judged in combination with the latitude and longitude lines in the figure, falls in southeastern Canada, near the Great Lakes-Saint Lawrence River.
Then reason: the main river near this place should be the Saint Lawrence River system. The Saint Lawrence River flows northeast into the Gulf of Saint Lawrence, and then leads to the Atlantic Ocean. The outer side of the Gulf of Saint Lawrence is near the world-famous fishing ground near Newfoundland, namely the Newfoundland fishing ground. The Newfoundland fishing ground is located in the western North Atlantic, so the famous fishing ground adjacent to the sea area into which this river flows is located in the western North Atlantic.
